local function tag_substitution(text)
	if not text then
		return text end
	--test only
	text = text:gsub("<test>", "[[File:Heat.png|15px|link=]] <span style='color:#FF8E59'>")
	--start of text color tags substitution
	text = text:gsub("<stagger>", "<span style='color:#FFAE6B'>")
	text = text:gsub("<phys>", "<span style='color:#D3B591'>")
	text = text:gsub("<arts>", "<span style='color:#33C2FF'>")
	text = text:gsub("<heat>", "<span style='color:#FF8E59'>")
	text = text:gsub("<electric>", "<span style='color:#FFCC00'>")
	text = text:gsub("<cryo>", "<span style='color:#30D6E0'>")
	text = text:gsub("<nature>", "<span style='color:#B4D945'>")
	text = text:gsub("<aether>", "<span style='color:#C59EFF'>")
	--start of icon tags substitution
	text = text:gsub("<ivulnerable>", "[[File:Vulnerable icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ilift>", "[[File:Lift icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iknockdown>", "[[File:Knock Down icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<icrush>", "[[File:Crush icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ibreach>", "[[File:Breach icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	text = text:gsub("<iheat>", "[[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ielectric>", "[[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<icryo>", "[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<inature>", "[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	text = text:gsub("<icombust>", "[[File:Combustion icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ielectrify>", "[[File:Electrification icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<isolidify>", "[[File:Solidification icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<icorrosion>", "[[File:Corrosion icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	text = text:gsub("<iamp>", "[[File:Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iartsamp>", "[[File:Arts Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iheatamp>", "[[File:Heat Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ielecticamp>", "[[File:Electric Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<icryoamp>", "[[File:Cryo Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<inatureamp>", "[[File:Nature Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	text = text:gsub("<isus>", "[[File:Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iphysicalsus>", "[[File:Physical Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iartssus>", "[[File:Arts Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iheatsus>", "[[File:Heat Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ielectricsus>", "[[File:Electric Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<icryosus>", "[[File:Cryo Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<inaturesus>", "[[File:Nature Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	text = text:gsub("<ilink>", "[[File:Link icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iprotect>", "[[File:Protect icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ihaste>", "[[File:Haste icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<islow>", "[[File:Slow icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<iweaken>", "[[File:Weaken icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	text = text:gsub("<ishatter>", "[[File:Shatter icon.png|15px|link=]]")
	
	return text
end

for _, v in pairs(data) do
	v.desc = tag_substitution(v.desc)
	v.name = tag_substitution(v.name)
	v.icon = tag_substitution(v.icon)
end

return data
